item.title: Routers hijacked, identity servers handing out admin
item.description: Good morning, it's 5:22 AM. It's Monday, the seventh of September, twenty twenty-six. 522 AM is brought to you by Lab522, a technology partner for mid-market businesses, providing cyber security services and enterprise operational software. Email hello at lab522 dot co dot uk if you think we can help your business. Start with MikroTik: attackers are chaining two recently disclosed RouterOS flaws to take over routers with SSH exposed to the internet.
